messages:
sam: Quick sync — proposing new runtime telemetry for Console dashboards, need to coordinate exporters/aggregates/retention before next sprint. Key metrics: runtime_prefix_cache_hit_rate, kv_cache_latency_p50/p95, model_fallback_count, per-route_quota_rejections/min, request_size_buckets.

mira: SGTM. Do we want 1m or 5m aggregation? 1m is noisy but useful for incidents.

lia: 1m for alerting, 5m/1h for dashboard rollups. Also we should avoid cardinality explosion from route tags — need conservative tagging.

ashok: Exporter changes: can add route tag sampling to reduce cardinality. Needs instrumentation in runtime — estimated 2 dev-days + CI.

toni: Retention: metrics store defaults to 90d. Product asked for 1y for billing/audit. Suggest 90d for high-card metrics, 1y for rollups/aggregates.

sam: Can the pipeline support dual retention? If not, we need a downsample job. Also need backfill plan for last 30d for historical dashboards.

dev-bot: Deploy scheduled: metrics-exporter:v2.3 will roll tomorrow 03:00 UTC.

mira: Backfill cost estimate: rough calc — 200M events/day * 30d ~ 6B raw events. After aggregation to 5m windows we'll store ~200k rows/day. Compute for backfill ~ 4 CPU-hours/day, S3 storage ~ $30. These are ballpark numbers.

lia: We should chunk backfill by route group and throttle. Pause during peak hours to avoid affecting tail latency.

ashok: I'll open exporter PR with route_tag sampling + a new metric prefix `rw.runtime.*`. Need review from eng-telemetry and infra.

toni: @ashok please include config flags so infra can flip without redeploy: `exporter.sample_rate`, `exporter.route_categories`. Also add a feature-flag for enabling route-level tags per-customer.

ash: For Console UX: surface if a metric is sampled/downsampled. Tooltip + provenance badge (sampled / aggregated window / retention). Helps analysts trust numbers.

sam: Decision summary so we can lock the ticket: 1) aggregation windows: 1m for alerts, 5m for dashboards, 1h rollup for long term 2) retention: 90d for high-card metrics, 1y for aggregates 3) exporter changes: route tag sampling + config flags 4) backfill: chunked, off-peak, cost cap $200 estimate 5) PR deadline EOD Fri. Agree?

toni: :thumbsup: Agree, will add to rollout ticket and owner list.

mira: I'll schedule a short sync with Telemetry next Tue to walk schema + examples, + include sample dashboards for reviewers.

sam: Thanks — if anyone expects blockers for the 2-day work (ashok/lia) call them out now. Otherwise I'll create the Jira and assign reviewers.

ashok: No blockers on my side, will start the PR tomorrow.

lia: Will need a small runtime tweak to expose `kv_cache_latency_ms` histogram buckets, adding to my queue.

sam: Great. Closing loop — I'll post the ticket link here when created.
